footer.description: Vertical integration from hardware to craftsmanship knowledge. Domestic industrial SoC + openEuler → openIndu-studio → Industrial Vision/Edge/IIoT → Craftsmanship Knowledge Base. Domestic chip, full-stack open source, cross-brand support, data-driven closed loop.

edgeComputing.description: Edge computing platform for industrial automation
edgeComputing.subtitle: Industrial edge computing platform for real-time control, data processing, and distributed automation
edgeComputing.realtimeDesc: Instant response to equipment signals without cloud latency
edgeComputing.securityDesc: On-premise data processing keeps sensitive manufacturing data local
edgeComputing.connectDesc: Multi-protocol support: Modbus, EtherCAT, OPC-UA, CANopen
edgeComputing.perfDesc: Low-latency edge computation for mission-critical automation
edgeComputing.capabilitiesDesc: Everything you need for edge-based industrial automation
edgeComputing.useCase1Desc: Connect multiple edge nodes across production facilities with centralized management
edgeComputing.useCase2Desc: Process sensor data at the edge, aggregate to cloud for analytics and historical analysis

edgeComputing.useCase4Desc: Continue operating during connectivity loss, sync data when connection restored
edgeComputing.ctaDesc: Start building edge-powered automation. Open source, Apache 2.0, no vendor lock-in.

industrialControl.title: Industrial Control
industrialControl.description: PLC hardware and software, fieldbuses (EtherCAT, CANopen and others) and control-system architecture. Selection, integration and control-network design across PLC brands.

automation.title: Automation
automation.description: PLC programming, HMI development, machine vision and motion control. Equipment integration, engineering conventions and best practice.
